title: Biotinidase deficiency
everyday_terms: hair loss and skin rash in a baby
summary: Biotinidase deficiency means the body cannot reuse biotin, a B vitamin, properly. Without treatment, it can cause problems such as seizures, skin rashes and hearing loss.
inheritance_plain: It is inherited in an autosomal recessive way: a child is affected only if they get a changed copy of the BTD gene from both parents.
carrier_meaning: A carrier has one changed copy. Carriers are healthy and usually do not know they are carriers until they are tested.
disease_meaning: A person with two changed copies has biotinidase deficiency. Found early, it is treated simply under the care of a specialist team, and most people stay well.
screening: A carrier test uses a blood or saliva sample. It looks for the most common changes and cannot find every possible change.
suggested_questions: Someone in my family has biotinidase deficiency. Could I be a carrier?
